Ms. Moon Ong – Head of Operations

Ms. Moon Ong holds a Bachelor of Economics degree from the University of Malaya. Since 2018, she has been managing the operations of 23 Century International Life Science Centre, a position she continues to hold today. Prior to this, Ms. Ong served as a Special Officer to the Minister of Plantation Industries and Commodities. During her tenure in the Prime Minister’s Department, she was responsible for overseeing key government agencies, including the National Innovation Agency (AIM) and the Malaysian Nuclear Agency. With a strong background in public service and operational management, Ms. Ong has played a crucial role in advancing various initiatives in both the public and private sectors.
